items.targetPoint: 形容词性物主代词 his
物主代词后必须跟名词

items.userAnswer: My name is Zane. My English teacher is Amy. Her class is very good and intrusting. My friend is Tom. Our teacher is Amy together.
items.revisedAnswer: My name is Zane. My English teacher is Amy. Her class is very good and interesting. My friend is Tom. Tom and I are students, and our teacher is Amy.
items.errorNote: 两处：①拼写——intrusting → interesting；②用词——together 是「一起做某事」，不能说「老师是 Amy 一起」，应改为 Tom and I are students. Our teacher is Amy.。格式本轮全对（句首大写、句号后空格、人名大写），物主代词 my/her/our 用够 3 个，任务完成度合格。

mistakeCandidates.errorReason: 拼写错误：interesting（有趣的），重音在首，拼作 inter-est-ing

mistakeCandidates.correctText: Tom and I are students. Our teacher is Amy.
mistakeCandidates.errorReason: together 表示「一起做某事」，不能用于描述身份归属
